result.title: Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents
result.summary: Browser agents do not just need more practice. They need to practice the right things. We introduce MiniWeb, a realistic miniature of the web comprising 65 interconnected websites across 15 domains, where agents navigate, search, and transact as people do. Its 369 human-annotated tasks cover everyday workflows and label 37 reusable interaction primitives grouped into 7 skill families, allowing us to diagnose which skills fail rather than only whether a task succeeds. Benchmarking ten open-weight agents, we find that drag & gesture is consistently the weakest family, with no agent solving more than 24% of its instances. To address this gap, we introduce MiniWebGen, a framework that autonomously generates verified, skill-centric training data from MiniWeb. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-4B on just 3.1K verified trajectories improves single-primitive success by 24.9pp across 13 unseen websites, with gains across every skill family. However, these trajectories teach short-horizon interactions, which do not directly translate to full-task success. We build on this result with MiniWebAgent, which pairs the trained executor with a planner that decomposes full tasks into the skill-level steps it learned to perform. This approach improves task success by 19.4pp points on unseen MiniWeb sites and transfers to external benchmarks, with gains of 9.3pp on WebArena-Lite, 16.1pp on Online-Mind2Web, and 20.0pp on WebVoyager, without training on their trajectories. We provide a simple recipe for compact browser agents: practice reusable skills directly, then compose them to solve unfamiliar tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 MiniWeb：一个含 65 个互联网站、369 个人工标注任务并标注 37 个交互原语的微型网页环境，用于按技能族诊断网页智能体的失败；并提出 MiniWebGen 自动生成经过验证的技能级轨迹数据，配合规划器-执行器组合来提升完整任务成功率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按交互原语诊断失败—用短程技能轨迹微调—再由规划器组合成长程任务」的做法，可能与 LVR 中的步骤级监督、贡献分配以及短程技能到长程任务的泛化问题形成可核查的方法借鉴，但原文不涉及视觉推理中的 latent 状态或视觉证据保留，联系需人工判断。
